alignments.note: Portmanteau under rule 35: *Herein* spells the preposition into *-in* and the demonstrative into *Here-*, so both tokens take the one word, headed on the pronominal.
Discontinuous *is ... glorified*; the copula-auxiliary is the verb's own helper and the head is the lexical participle.
Rule 20: the genitive pronoun displaces the article's determiner, which *my* realizes.
Inflected verb takes its English subject; head on the lexical verb per rule 9.

Future of *become* rendered *so shall ye be*; the supplied *so* carries the resultative sense of the verb and is a rule 7 helper on it rather than `added` (rule 11). Reading *so* as `added` remains defensible.
Possessive adjective; the Greek is anarthrous, so no article competes for *my*.
